comp.script:
currentLimitFrom.resetValue()
  currentLimitTo.resetValue()
  currentAmount.resetValue()
  currentValidFrom.resetValue()
  currentValidTo.resetValue()
  detailOrder.setValue(1)

if(!changeCondition.value){
  currentRuleCode.resetValue()
  currentRuleName.resetValue()
  currentRulePeriod.resetValue()
  validFrom.resetValue()
  validTo.resetValue()
  currentRuleOrders.setValue(1)
}else{
  currentRuleCode.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.code)
  currentRuleName.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.name)
  currentRulePeriod.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.rule_period)
  currentRuleOrders.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.rule_order ?? 1)
  validFrom.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.valid_from)
  validTo.setValue(additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.valid_to)
}

comp.body:
query MyQuery($ruleId: uuid!) {
  MileageRule(where: {id: {_eq: $ruleId}, _and: {isDeleted: {_eq: false}}}) {
    id
    version
    activeFrom
    activeTo
    code
    name
    rulePeriod
    mileageRuleDetail(orderBy: {limitFrom: ASC_NULLS_LAST}, where: {_and: {isDeleted: {_eq: false}}}) {
      id
      version
      activeFrom
      activeTo
      amount
      limitFrom
      limitTo
      mileageRuleId
      updatedAt
      detailOrder
    }
  }
}
